title: Employment Standards Act
verified_how: Fetched the CiviX document 96113_01. The page heading reads 'Employment Standards Act [RSBC 1996] CHAPTER 113' and says 'This Act is current to September 15, 2026'. It has a live table of contents (Part 1, s. 3.1 Online platform workers, etc.).
notes: Covers wages, minimum wage (the rate itself is set by regulation), overtime, payment of wages and deductions. It also covers the next two topics (leave and termination).
